title: An Interview With Intuit CEO Sasan Goodarzi About Accounting and AI
summary:
Listen to this post:

Good morning,

This week’s Stratechery Interview is with Intuit CEO Sasan Goodarzi. Goodarzi took a very non-traditional path to Silicon Valley, joining Intuit in 2004 after working at Siemens and Honeywell. After managing business units across the company he became CEO in 2019, and is taking on the challenge of figuring out how one of tech’s oldest software companies manages the AI paradigm shift.

In this interview we discuss Goodarzi’s background and the what it takes to be an effective generalist, and get his take on how Intuit has thrived for 44 years. We discuss the shift from Quicken to Quickbooks, the TurboTax business, and how Goodarzi thinks about the consumer space today. title: An Interview With Roblox CEO David Baszucki About Aggregating Play
summary:
Listen to this post:

Good morning,

This week’s Stratechery Interview is with Roblox CEO David Baszucki. I’ve interviewed Baszucki twice, in February 2022, and November 2023.

What struck me about this interview is just how much AI has changed the landscape for Roblox. This was a company predicated on the concept that anyone can make a game, but now, for the first time, literally anyone can make a game. That means a world of abundance, and in that world, there is an opportunity to be an Aggregator, and Roblox is aggressively pursuing that opportunity.
